At TLA, everyone is kind and supportive. I've made lots of new friends.

Announcements
Year 6 Open Evening Thursday 1 October 2026 6pm - 8pm
This evening is the first step in our excellent transition programme. This dedicated programme will support your child to make a seamless move from primary school to secondary school.
Arrival time: We highly recommend you arrive at 5.45pm as it does get busy
Principal's Presentations: A short presentation will take place at 6.15pm and 7.15pm
Guided Tours: You can experience guided tours led by our current students, meet our staff and explore our facilities
Parking: Available for all guests in Fitzalan and Hill Road Car Parks
We look forward to welcoming you

Useful Sites
Google classroom & Google Drive. Go on to the TLA website and use Realsmart to access https://vle.tla.academy
MyMaths - www.mymaths.co.uk
MyMaths provides a fully interactive online learning resource suitable for all ages and abilities right up to A-Level, and can be accessed 24/7 from school, home, or even when on holiday. Written by practising maths teachers for teachers and their students, MyMaths continually listens to teachers and responds to their needs. With this ethos still at its core, MyMaths has evolved over the years so that it now offers everything you need to teach mathematics and enthuse today’s students. Interactive lessons, games, and worksheets are linked to a powerful Assessment Manager system that enables you to teach in a fun and dynamic way while tracking and monitoring progress effectively.
Get Revising – www.getrevising.co.uk
Another tool the school has recently acquired to help with revision is www.getrevising.co.uk. Your son/daughter will have received an email with their log-in details last year and so if they haven’t logged in before, they should be able to find the original email in their school inbox. It is a fantastic ‘crowd-sourcing’ tool that allows students to share their revision notes online and have a look at others.
BBC GCSE Bitesize - www.bbc.co.uk/schools/gcsebitesize/
BBC GCSE Bitesize has been a huge help to many students throughout the years at TLA. It features revision pages for nearly every course offered at the school and has mini-quizzes to consolidate learning. This is not a subscription based website and therefore is easy to access and simple to use.
Kerboodle - https://www.kerboodle.com
Online textbooks and lesson materials. Great for independent learning! To log in go to www.kerboodle.com/users/login and use your USERNAME (first letter of your first name. eg: Ben Smith would be ‘bsmith’), your PASSWORD (Same as your username for the first login and then you can change it to something more secure) and use the institution code (ix7)
Edusites Media - https://media.edusites.co.uk/
offers a comprehensive collection of outstanding online Media Studies teaching resources to help teachers and students. Our Lesson by Lesson Online Slides, Teacher Schemes of Learning and Student Workbooks take both novices, non subject specialists and the seasoned teacher through the new and legacy specifications.
Memrise - https://www.memrise.com/
Find it a challenge to find different ways to revise? Memrise is a fantastic website and app that encourages you to use a range of technique to memorise and understand the content of a course. This tool has been specifically recommended by the English department and is worth exploring!
The EverLearner - https://theeverlearner.com/
This is for BTEC Sport L2 Unit 1 Fitness for Sport and Exercise. Exam board-specific online course, featuring fast-paced tutorials taught by James, practice and test mode quizzing and checkpoint assessments preparing you for your Unit 1 exam. We recommend that you study The Roadmap course along with this BTEC course.
Senecalearning.com - www.senecalearning.com
Seneca's smart learning algorithms make you remember topics better. When you get a question wrong, the content will be repeated in many different formats at the optimal time. It’s the only revision resource with GIFs and memes that will make you laugh instead of stressed. Time flies when using Seneca instead of traditional revision guides.

Careers
The Littlehampton Academy is committed to providing our students with a programme of careers education, information, advice and guidance (CEIAG) for all students in Years 7 to 13.
High quality careers education and guidance at TLA is critical for our students’ futures. It will help to prepare them for the workplace by providing a clear understanding of the world of work including the routes to jobs and careers that they might find engaging and rewarding. It supports students to acquire the self-development and career management skills they need to achieve positive employment, whilst supporting students to acquire the knowledge, skills and confident to fulfil their potential.
Benefits to learners
Students have both self and opportunity awareness
Demonstrating what is open to young people will act as a significant motivator
Higher levels of motivation will increase aspiration and help to pave the way for higher achievement
Well-planned CEIAG students are much more likely to make the right choices at transition points and will prevent NEETs and reduce dropout rates
What We Offer
A programme of Personal Development is available for every year group and the aim is to inspire students and to provide them with employability and lifelong learning skills to complement their qualifications. We promote communication, confidence, financial capability, initiative, organisation, problem-solving, resilience and teamwork amongst other skills.
Each student will have either a group careers interview or a 30-40 minute 1:1 interview with our internal and external Career Advisors to discuss their future plans along with preparing for job interviews, CV & Personal Statement writing and completing college and job application forms.
The focus is skills and qualities, future goals and dreams and how they link to jobs.
The focus is on careers and how to explore job skills and research dream jobs, using online careers programme Unifrog.
The focus is future careers, qualifications required and also looking at gender and jobs.
Students will have a work experience week in March. Students will also have the opportunity to be interviewed by an employer.
Each student will take part in a Tutor Group careers activity, looking and researching colleges, apprenticeships, future pathways, career
options and will be supported in making a college or sixth form application.
Students will have a 1:1 interview with our internal or external Level 6 trained Career Advisors to discuss their future plans.
Our Careers Leader is Mrs Gresty and she is based in the Careers Hub located in the Sixth Form building.
Our Work Experience Coordinator is Mrs Dear and she is based in the Sixth Form building.

pageCache.pageTitle: Accessing IT Resources - The Littlehampton Academy
pageCache.text:
Accessing IT Resources
We have put together some information below that will hopefully resolve most issues with regards to accessing IT resources.
Arbor
To set up your account go to https://login.arbor.sc and click Forgot your password? Please use your school email address if you are a student or the email address that you have supplied to the school if you are a Parent.
If you have a student at another school that is already using Arbor and you are having difficulty setting your password for The Littlehampton Academy. Please use our direct link below and click on first time user. Please note that the log in with google option is only available to staff. https://the-littlehampton-academy.uk.arbor.sc
Further instructions on how to log into your account or setting up the Parent App can be found in the following guide. The Parent App can be downloaded from either the Playstore on Android phones or the App Store on Apple iPhones. https://support.arbor-education.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020147458-Log-into-the-Parent-Portal-and-the-Parent-App#what-is-the-parent-portal--0-0
Further instructions on how to log into your account for Students can be found in the following guide. The Students app is now available.
https://support.arbor-education.com/hc/en-us/articles/360006651877-The-Student-Portal-Quick-tips-for-students
https://support.arbor-education.com/hc/en-us/articles/19459987383325-Logging-Into-and-using-the-Student-App
Email
The links on the website and the VLE now point to your Gmail mailbox. Please log in to google to access your account using your Academy username and password.
If you are setting up a phone or tablet we would suggest going back into the account and selecting Advanced. Then change the option for Move Discarded Messages from Archive to Deleted.
Webmail can be accessed at https://mail.gmail.com or the link on the school website / VLE
Your email address is your first initial, surname, intake year and "@tla.woodard.co.uk"
John Smith, Year 9 = jsmith22@tla.woodard.co.uk
Fred Smith, Year 11 = fsmith20@tla.woodard.co.uk
Your username for realsmart does not include the "@tla.woodard.co.uk"
Username example - jsmith22
Password - Same as you use to log onto google/VLE
Further Assistance
Should you require any further assistance please email us on
networkhelpdesk@tla.woodard.co.uk
Please include the following details in your email
Brief desciption of the problem.
Kind regards Network services
Google Classroom
To access google classroom, you will need to log in using the VLE You can access the VLE by either going to https://vle.tla.academy or the link on the school website.
Your username is your first initial followed by your surname and your intake year.
John Smith, Year 8 = jsmith23
Fred Smith, Year 10 = fsmith21
The password is case sensitive.
When you have logged in you will see the links at the top of the website for Google Drive and Google Classroom.
Sparx
To log in to Sparx Maths or Reader, you will need to log in using the VLE
You can access the VLE by either going to https://vle.tla.academy or the link on the school website.
Your username is your first initial followed by your surname and your intake year.
John Smith, Year 8 = jsmith23
Fred Smith, Year 10 = fsmith21
The password is case sensitive.
When you have logged in you will see 4 squares in the top right corner which will show other apps.
Select either Sparx Maths or Sparx Reader from the tiles.
Click 'Log in to Sparx using Google G'
